_comment: Reviewed evidence keyed by incident ID. Each review needs url (matching a cited source), reviewer, reviewed_at (ISO date), excerpt and type: organisation_statement, independent_report or denial. Independent reports additionally need independent_origin: the original evidence origin, not merely the publisher. Never count two reports repeating one claim as independent.
